description: This file defines the Response class and related functions for handling and serializing responses, including managing results, errors, code snippets, snapshots, and logs within a testing or automation framework, specifically for Playwright.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class for constructing, managing, and serializing response data including results, errors, code snippets, snapshots, and logs.

methods.name: resolveClientFile
methods.description: Resolves a filename for client output, suggesting a filename if provided.

methods.name: resolveClientFilename
methods.description: Resolves a filename within the workspace.

methods.name: addTextResult
methods.description: Adds a text result to the response.

methods.name: addResult
methods.description: Adds a result, either as a file or inline text, depending on configuration.

methods.name: addFileResult
methods.description: Writes data to a file and adds a link to the result.

methods.name: addFileLink
methods.description: Adds a link to a file result.

methods.name: registerImageResult
methods.description: Registers an image result for inclusion in the response.

methods.name: setClose
methods.description: Marks the response as a close operation.

methods.name: setIncludeSnapshot
methods.description: Sets the snapshot inclusion mode to 'full' or 'incremental'.

methods.name: setIncludeFullSnapshot
methods.description: Sets the snapshot mode to 'full' and optionally specifies a filename.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the response into a structured result, including text, images, and metadata.

methods.name: _build
methods.description: Builds the sections of the response for serialization.
